dataset: National Heritage List for England (NHLE) v02 — Listed Building polygons
evidence_slice: Historic England's official NHLE v02 FeatureServer layer 3 is named 'Listed Building polygons', has geometry type esriGeometryPolygon, exposes ListEntry, Name, Grade, ListDate, AmendDate, CaptureScale, hyperlink, area_ha, NGR, Easting and Northing fields, supports JSON/GeoJSON/PBF queries, and reports a 2026-09-01 data/schema edit date. The selected new source window filters Exeter by Easting 288000..299000, Northing 88000..100000 and ListDate on or after 2011-04-04, caps results at 50 and requests geometry. The web retrieval channel rejected the parameterized query URL, and a direct no-login HTTP attempt failed at DNS resolution before any feature payload was returned.

field_evidence.footprint: Official layer 3 is esriGeometryPolygon and the selected query requested returnGeometry=true, but no feature payload was retrievable; no polygon coordinates were read.
field_evidence.type_use: Official layer metadata binds Name to the same polygon feature schema, but no selected feature payload was retrievable, so no record-bound building type/use evidence was accepted.
field_evidence.window: New attribute-filtered Exeter window uses Easting/Northing plus ListDate>=2011-04-04, capped at 50; it is not the prior geometry-envelope bbox or exact-ListEntry query.
